Package com.saicone.settings.source

Class TomlSettingsSource

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.settings.source.TomlSettingsSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
SettingsSource
public class TomlSettingsSource extends Object implements SettingsSource
A settings source for toml-formatted data
This class uses electronwill nightconfig library to read and write any data.
